name: Labrador Retriever
tagline: The ultimate friendly adventure partner and family companion
description: Labradors thrive on active lifestyles, outdoor weekend excursions, and homes with bustling social energy. Their boundless enthusiasm matches people who love staying on the move.
ideal_lifestyle: Suburban or rural homes with access to trails, parks, and dog-friendly gatherings.

name: French Bulldog
tagline: The stylish, low-maintenance urban coffee shop regular
description: Compact, easygoing, and deeply fond of human companionship, the Frenchie is tailor-made for city living, cafe hopping, and cozy evenings on the sofa.
ideal_lifestyle: Downtown apartments, hybrid or remote workers, and relaxed neighborhood strollers.

name: Border Collie
tagline: The brilliant workaholic built for trail runners and outdoor strategists
description: Ranked among the smartest breeds on earth, Border Collies require serious mental engagement and intense daily cardio. They thrive alongside endurance athletes and trail runners.
ideal_lifestyle: Active outdoor enthusiasts with ample outdoor space and dedicated training routines.

name: Shiba Inu
tagline: Independent, dignified, and low-drama aesthetic icon
description: Often called the 'cat of the dog world', Shibas are clean, composed, and don't demand constant validation. They suit people who value boundaries and quiet sophistication.
ideal_lifestyle: Urban or townhouse professionals who appreciate an independent, proud companion.

name: Cavalier King Charles Spaniel
tagline: Gentle, velvety emotional support shadow who loves cuddle sessions
description: Cavaliers are sweet, eager to cuddle, and remarkably gentle. They thrive on human proximity and melt seamlessly into tranquil home routines and cafe visits.
ideal_lifestyle: Remote workers, quiet households, and city dwellers seeking a soulful cuddle buddy.

name: Golden Retriever
tagline: Pure joy in canine form with an open heart for everyone
description: Golden Retrievers embrace life with unbridled optimism. They love weekend picnics, swimming, park days, and greeting every guest as if they're a long-lost friend.
ideal_lifestyle: Active families, suburban homes, or nature lovers with plenty of social visits.

name: Italian Greyhound
tagline: Elegant, gentle couch sunbather with burst-speed playfulness
description: The Iggy is a sculpture in motion: sleek, whisper-quiet, and fond of tucking under warm cashmere blankets. They need short daily zoomies followed by 20 hours of napping.
ideal_lifestyle: Warm, peaceful city apartments and design-conscious minimalists.

name: Australian Shepherd
tagline: Dynamic, vibrant adventurer ready for mountain summits
description: Aussies thrive on challenges, hiking miles, frisbee games, and outdoor expeditions. They form intense bonds with owners who treat life as an ongoing athletic excursion.
ideal_lifestyle: Outdoor athletes, trail backpackers, and owners with spacious yards.

name: Pembroke Welsh Corgi
tagline: Big personality in a compact, spirited herding package
description: Corgis possess the heart of a big dog in a low-profile body. They are cheeky, bold, and fiercely entertaining, making them fantastic companions for active urbanites.
ideal_lifestyle: Apartments or townhomes with consistent walking schedules and playful owners.

name: Standard Poodle
tagline: Genius-level intellect paired with elegant athletic versatility
description: Beneath the pristine coat is a sharp, Olympic-level athlete that learns routines in minutes. Excellent for allergy-conscious individuals who value intelligence and charm.
ideal_lifestyle: Versatile urban or suburban homes with owners who enjoy brain games and grooming routines.

name: Dachshund (Wiener Dog)
tagline: Clever, courageous little explorer with plenty of quirky grit
description: Curious, tenacious, and fiercely loyal to their favorite human. Dachshunds pack massive attitude into a compact frame and love cozy burrowing under duvets.
ideal_lifestyle: City apartments, cozy flats, and owners who appreciate comedic personality.

name: Basset Hound
tagline: The soulful, slow-strolling zen master of leisurely weekends
description: If your ideal day involves sleeping in, a relaxed stroll through the park, and zero rush, the Basset Hound is your canine soulmate.
ideal_lifestyle: Low-speed households, relaxed weekends, and owners without stairs or hurry.

name: Samoyed
tagline: A beaming cloud of joy, winter resilience, and social sweetness
description: Famous for the permanent 'Sammy smile', Samoyeds love everyone they encounter. They adore crisp weather, long brisk walks, and participating in household conversations.
ideal_lifestyle: Cooler climates, active social households with time for brushing rituals.

name: Whippet
tagline: Quiet, gentle sprinter: 10 minutes of speed, 23 hours of napping
description: Rarely barks, has virtually zero dog odor, and loves curl-ups. Whippets give you the beauty of a sighthound with the quiet serenity of an apartment-friendly pet.
ideal_lifestyle: Quiet apartments or urban homes with a safe enclosed spot for occasional sprints.

name: Bengal
tagline: A mini domestic leopard bursting with jungle agility and curiosity
description: Bengals don't just walk—they leap onto doors, play in running water, and chase toys like wild cats. They need interactive play and stimulating vertical cat furniture.
ideal_lifestyle: Active, engaging homes with cat trees, puzzle toys, and owners ready for high-energy play.

name: Ragdoll
tagline: Silky-soft, sapphire-eyed teddy bear that goes limp in your arms
description: True to their name, Ragdolls relax completely when held. They greet you at the door, follow you room to room, and prefer peaceful indoor serenity over chaos.
ideal_lifestyle: Work-from-home creatives, quiet apartments, and owners wanting a devoted feline shadow.

name: Siamese
tagline: The conversationalist intellectual who narrates every waking hour
description: Siamese cats have unmistakable blue almond eyes and love having vocal debates with you. They crave constant interaction, social stimulation, and lap time.
ideal_lifestyle: Engaged owners who work from home and enjoy lively, talkative company.

name: British Shorthair
tagline: The plush, dignified aristocrat who minds their own business
description: Round-faced and teddy-bear-like, the British Shorthair sits nearby keeping you company without clinging or demanding constant picking up. Very self-sufficient.
ideal_lifestyle: Busy professionals, hybrid workers, and bookish apartments.

name: Sphynx
tagline: Hairless hot-water bottle seeking warmth and unconditional adoration
description: Endlessly affectionate, funny, and warm to the touch, Sphynx cats live to snuggle inside your sweater or under your duvet. They are natural clowns and adore attention.
ideal_lifestyle: Warm indoor apartments, constant cuddlers, and people who appreciate eccentric beauty.

name: Maine Coon
tagline: The gentle giant of the cat kingdom with tufted ears and dog-like charm
description: Substantial, fluffy, and fascinated by water, Maine Coons behave almost like dogs. They love following you, chirping softly, and playing fetch with paper balls.
ideal_lifestyle: Spacious apartments or homes with room for large cat beds and climbing structures.

name: Russian Blue
tagline: Silvery, emerald-eyed zen presence for peaceful sanctuaries
description: Russian Blues are cautious around strangers but develop deep, unbreakable bonds with their chosen person. They dislike loud commotion and thrive in serene, orderly environments.
ideal_lifestyle: Calm, quiet apartments, remote creatives, and sensory-friendly households.

name: Scottish Fold
tagline: Owl-eyed cutie who loves sitting like a tiny human on the sofa
description: Recognizable by their folded ears and signature 'Buddha pose' sit, Scottish Folds are mild-mannered, sweet, and quiet companions who get along with everyone.
ideal_lifestyle: Peaceful city homes, relaxed family spaces, and cozy media rooms.

name: Abyssinian
tagline: Agile, inquisitive acrobat who views your home as a vertical jungle gym
description: Abyssinians are in perpetual motion, exploring top shelves, refrigerator summits, and investigating every bag brought through the front door. Deeply engaging and fun.
ideal_lifestyle: Enthusiastic pet owners with high vertical perches and interactive playtime.

name: Persian
tagline: The quintessential quiet glamor cat who prefers resting on silk cushions
description: Quiet, placid, and lavishly coated, the Persian is content to pose gracefully on plush furniture. They rarely jump high and prefer calm predictability over sudden surprises.
ideal_lifestyle: Predictable, gentle indoor spaces with owners devoted to daily brushing.
